mapper.sql: select t.intervene_id, t.student_id, t.subject_id, t.source_type, t.source_id, t.knowledge_ids, t.title, t.target_rate, t.baseline_rate, t.baseline_json, t.status, t.owner_by, t.due_date, t.close_time, t.effect_rate, t.effect_delta, t.effect_passed, t.create_by, t.create_time, t.update_by, t.update_time, t.remark, s.student_name, s.student_no, s.dept_id, d.dept_name, sub.subject_name from spas_intervene_task t left join spas_student s on s.student_id = t.student_id left join sys_dept d on d.dept_id = s.dept_id left join spas_subject sub on sub.subject_id = t.subject_id
mapper.select: where t.student_id = #{studentId} order by t.create_time desc
select count(*) from spas_intervene_task where student_id = #{studentId} and status = '0'
